facts.fact: Adwave daily budgets start at $30 per day, according to its pricing page.
facts.quote: Adwave daily budgets start at $30, with a range up to $10,000 per day and no subscription or contract, per the pricing page.

facts.fact: According to the pricing page, TikTok starts at $91 per day on Adwave and must be turned on in Customize and connected to a TikTok account.
facts.quote: TikTok starts at $91 per day and needs you to turn it on in Customize and connect your TikTok account.

facts.fact: The pricing page lists mobile web, apps, TV, Google (YouTube and Demand Gen), Facebook and Instagram, Reddit, and Google Search as included channels.
facts.quote: The pricing page lists mobile web, apps, and TV, Google (YouTube and Demand Gen), Facebook and Instagram, Reddit, and Google Search as included.

facts.fact: Adwave says users can see their audience and preview their ads before adding a payment card.
facts.quote: says you can see your audience and preview your ads before adding a card.

facts.fact: Checking what Adwave finds on a website costs nothing, according to Adwave's guidance.
facts.quote: Checking what Adwave finds costs nothing.

facts.fact: A campaign on Adwave pauses when its prepaid wallet cannot cover the daily budget, and auto-refill from a saved card is optional.
facts.quote: A campaign pauses when its wallet can’t cover the daily budget, and auto-refill from a saved card is optional.

facts.fact: Adwave lets advertisers target by radius, ZIP codes, a city, or a national audience.
facts.quote: Adwave lets you target a radius, ZIP codes, a city, or a national audience.

facts.fact: Landing pages made through the Adwave app are included with business campaigns.
facts.quote: Landing pages made through the app are included with business campaigns

facts.fact: Adwave allows users to choose a setup-by-hand option and describe their business instead of providing a website.
facts.quote: Adwave lets you choose a setup-by-hand option and describe your business instead.

facts.fact: Adwave reads a website for offers and photos, suggests customer profiles, and drafts ads for TV, search, social, and the web.
facts.quote: It reads the site for offers and photos, suggests the customers worth reaching, and creates ads for TV, search, social, and the web.

facts.fact: In Adwave's workflow, users review the audience and ads, including image ads, social video, and a TV spot, and can refine creative before approving it.
facts.quote: you then review the audience and ads: image ads, social video, and a TV spot.

facts.fact: Adwave's ads step lets users preview and edit creative before launch, and users can upload finished ads they already have.
facts.quote: the ads step lets you preview and edit creative before launch, and you can also upload finished ads you already have.

facts.fact: When conversions carry values, Adwave can report revenue and return on spend instead of only conversion counts.
facts.quote: With values in place, Adwave can report revenue and return on spend instead of just counts.

facts.fact: A Lift experiment is the Adwave tool for estimating incremental impact, meaning conversions that would not have happened without the ads.
facts.quote: A Lift experiment is the tool when you need to estimate incremental impact

facts.fact: Adwave does not guarantee sales or a return on spend, and its forecasts are estimates.
facts.quote: Adwave doesn’t guarantee sales or a return on spend.
